title: Intraoperative recordings of medianus stimulation with low and high impedance ECoG
description: Intraoperative electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings of median nerve somatosensory evoked potentials (SEP) from 10 patients undergoing brain tumor resection in the perirolandic region. Two 4-contact ECoG strips, one low impedance (LoZ) and one high impedance (HiZ), were recorded simultaneously to compare fast ripple and high frequency oscillation detection. The data comprise continuous raw ECoG in BIDS format.
methods_description: Median nerve SEPs were recorded intraoperatively (stimulation rate 4.7 Hz) from two simultaneously placed 4-contact ECoG strips with different median impedance (LoZ 3.4 kΩ, HiZ 6.9 kΩ). Continuous iEEG was saved as EDF and converted to BIDS using bids-starter-kid and custom Matlab scripts. Analysis in the source paper averaged 100 sweeps and band-filtered them to obtain N20, fast ripple and HFO responses.
